items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: He was around Milwaukee at that time.

ctx.x: Yes, I think he was. Yes, he was around there.
Had Leonard Gay come into Milwaukee yet? No. He later came later. And you said that Bernie Young was not playing the group. No. He was around Milwaukee at that time.
I think he was. I'm pretty sure he was.
